I have two small dogs, and I was concerned about their barking during walks, so I had Ms. Shinohara focus on their walks during her dog training sessions!

She taught me how to communicate with my dogs in a very easy-to-understand and practical way, and even though it's only been four training sessions, I can already see significant improvement! ✨
Besides walks, she also kindly listened to my concerns about things happening at home and gave me precise advice, so both my dogs and I are growing together, which is a great help.

It's getting hot, so we're taking a break from walk training for now, but I plan to ask for her help again when it cools down. 🐾
I highly recommend her to anyone with concerns about their dog! ✨

I wanted to properly train my puppy from a young age, so I signed up for their boarding training program. The trainer's explanations were very easy to understand, and they taught me many important things about our future living environment. The detailed report with videos made it easy to review everything. I would definitely use their services again if needed.

My dog ​​used to pull so hard on the leash that walks were a real struggle, but after several training sessions at your facility, it improved dramatically. The reports, with both videos and written explanations, were very easy to understand, and I was able to handle home training without any problems. The after-sales support was also incredibly helpful. I look forward to continuing to work with you in the future.

This was my dog's first grooming experience. They took great care from shampooing to the final touches, and I was so happy to see him come back fluffy and smelling wonderful. I think the quality of the shampoo was definitely different. My dog ​​is usually quite nervous, but I was relieved that he was able to relax throughout the process, probably because a trainer was always on-site. He was still full of energy and playful when we got home. I'll definitely be using their services again.

I always appreciate your services.

I'm always very satisfied with the results, and I feel confident leaving my dog ​​in your care because he's always so happy to go for grooming!

I look forward to using your services again.

Thank you for always letting us use your services 😊 My dog ​​is always so happy when we enter the shop, and the staff are always so warm and welcoming; it's a really nice atmosphere ☺️
We would love to use your services again, so please continue to support us in the future 🌟
We've used their services several times, and each time I go to pick up my child, they're playing happily with their friends, which makes me happy because it shows they're relaxed.

This is my third time using their service.

My dog ​​is quite nervous at the beginning, but he always greets me with a satisfied look when I pick him up!

They provide thorough counseling, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them.

This is a place where your beloved dog will be cared for peacefully.

You can leave your dog here with peace of mind, as they will have a happy time as if they were at home. Another attractive feature is that they don't have to wait in a cage before or after grooming; they can play freely. The grooming is also done very well, and your dog will come back looking adorable.
They always take such good care of me. Their haircuts are excellent!
Booking is easy via LINE, and they always provide thorough updates and take cute photos, so I feel at ease leaving my pet there.

I feel completely at ease leaving my 15-year-old senior dog there. They also respond well to any changes in his health. He doesn't like being left alone, but he seems to enjoy being left here, and when I come back he's beaming with satisfaction, which makes me so glad I left him there. I also look forward to reading the daily log, which gives me a clear understanding of how he's doing at DogFan and puts my mind at ease. I'll continue to bring him here happily! Thank you very much.
They send me photos of my pet every day, which makes me trust them completely. The staff also seem to treat my pet kindly, so I feel at ease leaving my pet with them.

I used their grooming service. Thank you for always making my dog ​​look so cute. This time, I also opted for the summer-recommended herbal bath and premium paw cream, and I'm very happy with the extra fluffiness and lovely scent.

I appreciate that they also provide photos, videos, and a daily log after grooming.

They have a dog run, the staff are kind, and my dog ​​seems to enjoy herself, so I feel completely at ease leaving her in their care.

This was our second time having our dogs groomed here!

Both of our dogs have birthdays this month, and we were very happy that they took birthday photos for us and even gave us a discount! ⭐︎

It was a wonderful grooming salon!

I would definitely like to use their services again next time!

Thank you very much for visiting us!

The salon was very clean and executive, and Romeo seemed to be able to relax. The black frog was adorable, and we will definitely come again. Thank you very much.

This salon is newly opened in Minami-Aoyama, so I asked them to shampoo my Bedlington Terrier. The results were so beautiful, I would definitely come back. The salon is clean and the staff are very friendly. I would definitely come back.

Recently, due to work circumstances, I urgently needed to leave my dog ​​(Shiba Inu, female, 3 years old) with someone, and a friend recommended this place. It's conveniently located just a 5-minute walk from the Nishi-Azabu intersection. My dog ​​is a little shy around strangers, but the staff took their time to interact with her carefully, and I was relieved to see that she had been calm when I picked her up. The room was spacious, and it seems she had a comfortable stay. I would like to request long-term boarding next time.
